items.exampleEn: Please be quiet. I'm trying to concentrate.
Many people disagree with the new rule.
items.exampleZh: 很多人不同意這條新規定。

items.exampleEn: The window is broken. Whose fault is it?
Please drive more carefully, for my sake.
items.exampleZh: 為了我，請開車小心一點。

items.exampleEn: Being a little late is acceptable here.
items.exampleZh: 在這裡稍微遲到是可以接受的。

items.exampleEn: The future of the old theater is uncertain.
items.exampleZh: 那間老戲院的未來還很不確定。

items.exampleEn: Living far from school has some disadvantages.
items.exampleZh: 住得離學校遠有一些缺點。

items.sentenceEn: Don't worry. Nobody is at fault.
items.sentenceZh: 別擔心，這不是任何人的錯。

items.audioEn: I can't concentrate because my brother is playing music.
items.audioZh: 我沒辦法專心，因為我弟弟在放音樂。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼沒辦法專心？
options: The speaker's brother is playing music
The speaker's room is much too cold today

items.sentenceEn: I'm uncertain about my plans for the summer.
items.sentenceZh: 我還不確定暑假的計畫。

items.sentenceEn: Is it acceptable to wear jeans to the party?
items.sentenceZh: 穿牛仔褲去派對可以嗎？

items.stemEn: Your work is not ____. Please do it again.
items.stemZh: 你的作業不合格，請重做一次。

items.stemEn: My brother and I often ____ about what to watch on TV.
items.stemZh: 我和哥哥常常為了看什麼電視意見不合。

items.passageEn: My family is uncertain about moving to a new city. My father wants to go for his new job, but my mother disagrees. "One disadvantage is that the kids will lose their friends," she says. My father says it's acceptable if we visit our old town often. "We are doing this for the children's sake," he says. I just look at my phone screen and can't concentrate on my homework. But I know it's nobody's fault.
items.passageZh: 我們家還不確定要不要搬到新城市。爸爸因為新工作想搬，但媽媽不同意。她說：「其中一個缺點是孩子們會失去朋友。」爸爸說，只要我們常回老家看看，這是可以接受的。他說：「我們這麼做是為了孩子們。」我只是盯著手機螢幕，沒辦法專心寫作業。不過我知道這不是任何人的錯。

questions.questionZh: 媽媽說搬家的一個缺點是什麼？
爸爸說他們搬家是為了誰？

rubricZh: disagree 後面接 with＋人或意見（例如 disagree with you）

items.instructionZh: 用 fault 造一個句子，說說某件事是誰的錯，或安慰別人那不是他的錯。
referenceEn: It was my fault that we were late.
The accident was not the driver's fault.
rubricZh: fault 指「過錯；責任」（例如 my fault、not your fault）
可寫例如 It was my fault that…

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關疑似 S8：聽打句和單字卡都是 It's … fault 句型，改成不同句型
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Don't worry. Nobody is at fault."（原 "It's not your fault. Don't worry."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合聽打句修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "別擔心，這不是任何人的錯。"（原 "這不是你的錯，別擔心。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：Your work is not acceptable 譯「你的作業不及格」不忠實（原文是『不能接受／不合格』，沒有考試及格的意思），work 也不一定是作業。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "你的作業不合格，請重做一次。"（原 "你的作業不及格，請重做一次。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：正解長度名次分布：a2-u23-l05-q09 目標第 2 長、消除單題異常值（改了選項 1、3）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["She is very hungry","Her brother is playing music","The room is much too cold for her"]（原 ["She is hungry","Her brother is playing music","The room is too cold for her"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：情境對照表逐列重判：和造句參考答案「It was my fault that we were late.」主詞、句型（It's … fault）相同，改單字卡例句
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "The window is broken. Whose fault is it?"（原 "It's the computer's fault, not mine!"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合例句修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "窗戶破了，是誰的錯？"（原 "是電腦的錯，不是我的！"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：情境對照表逐列重判：和閱讀「One disadvantage is that…」主詞、句型相同，改單字卡例句
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Living far from school has some disadvantages."（原 "The only disadvantage of this house is the noise."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合例句修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "住得離學校遠有一些缺點。"（原 "這間房子唯一的缺點是很吵。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：音檔是第一人稱，選項用 She／Her 可能和 TTS 性別不一致；改成 The speaker，正解仍排第 2 長、無異常值
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["The speaker is very hungry","The speaker's brother is playing music","The speaker's room is much too cold today"]（原 ["She is very hungry","Her brother is playing music","The room is much too cold for her"]）
